subject.title: feat(discord/voice): add sessionChannelId to autoJoin for text-channel transcript routing

question: Should Discord voice text routing be added as a per-autoJoin sessionChannelId field, or should maintainers extend the existing voice.agentSession target model instead?
rationale: Both options affect public Discord voice config and message delivery semantics, and current main already has a related global routing surface without automatic text mirroring.

options.title: Resolve through the fork candidate
options.body: Review or replace the open fork PR, requiring it to align types, schema, docs, tests, delivery semantics, and same-guild target validation before merge.

options.title: Use voice.agentSession only
options.body: Decline the per-autoJoin field and extend the existing voice.agentSession design if automatic text mirroring should be one global Discord voice mode.

options.title: Defer text mirroring
options.body: Keep current voice.agentSession routing as the supported same-session path and defer visible transcript/reply mirroring until a broader voice-as-I/O design is accepted.

recommendation.title: Resolve through the fork candidate
recommendation.body: Review or replace the open fork PR, requiring it to align types, schema, docs, tests, delivery semantics, and same-guild target validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the current related routing surface and have already reviewed this issue's exact source path.
